sentences.en: Television enables us to learn about foreign manners and customs.
sentences.zh: 电视使我们能够了解外国的风俗习惯。

sentences.en: This enables me to see and face my present trouble.
sentences.zh: 这使我能够面对当前的问题。

sentences.en: This bird's large wings enable it to fly very fast.
sentences.zh: 这只鸟宽大的翅膀使它能飞得非常快。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（使…）+able（能够的）→使能够，使成为可能
